newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Barely changed European feeds see few soy trades.
newsitem.headline: Barely changed European feeds see few soy trades.

text.p: Most products on the European meals and feeds market started barely changed from yesterday with a few early trades reported, market sources said.
Dec Argentine soymeal pellets traded unchanged at $282 a tonne cif Rotterdam and Jan at $280 a tonne cif.
No trades were reported in other products during the early stages of the market.
"Barely changed seller prices coupled to a firm dollar and Chicago futures market closed for Thanksgiving Day kept most buyers sidelined this morning," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
